component.name: BLOODRUSH
component.summary: Fast-paced retro arena FPS where blood is fuel

description.p: BLOODRUSH is a frantic first-person arena shooter inspired by classic movement shooters. Health never regenerates on its own — the only way to heal is to deal damage up close. Keep moving or die.

ul.li: Movement-first gameplay: bunny hopping, dashing, sliding and ground slams
Two weapons: a hitscan revolver with a charged piercing alt-fire and a projectile shotgun
Three enemy types, including one whose projectiles you can shoot out of the air
Endless waves of increasing difficulty with a score counter
A style meter ranking you from D up to ULTRAVIOLENT
Retro low-poly look rendered at 480p and upscaled with crunchy pixels
Fully procedural sound effects — no asset files at all

screenshot.caption: Blasting husks with the shotgun in the arena
The arena from the spawn platform

description.p: First release: movement core, two weapons, three enemy types, endless waves, style meter, blood healing, procedural audio.
